name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
headline: Ponytail pushes coding agents toward writing less code
lede: You can steer an AI agent to prefer not writing code at all, using a lazy-senior-dev mindset.

effects.effect: May shrink agent diffs if the approach holds up

appearances.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
appearances.summary: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

appearances.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
appearances.headline: Ponytail pushes coding agents toward writing less code
appearances.newly_possible: You can steer an AI agent to prefer not writing code at all, using a lazy-senior-dev mindset.
appearances.why: Less generated code can mean smaller diffs and less to review.
appearances.limits: No evidence yet that it improves quality or reduces review load.

ripples.effect: May shrink agent diffs if the approach holds up
